verdict.rationale: Wave documents its own recurring automation, but only for specific accounting tasks: recurring invoices with automatic billing, and overdue reminders scheduled at 3, 7 and 14 days. There is no general-purpose scheduler for arbitrary jobs or workflows, and no API, CLI or MCP surface for AI-native users to define schedules. Missing for 10: a general recurring job/workflow scheduler, programmatic or agent-accessible scheduling, configurable schedule definitions beyond invoices and reminders, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Set up recurring invoices and automatic credit card payments for your repeat customers and stop chasing payments.
Send recurring invoices with total flexibility. Switch between automatic and manual billing whenever you want.
Schedule reminders to automatically deploy 3, 7, and 14 days after sent invoices are due
